note: Synthetic staff questions worded differently from the organization documents (A3 of the backend optimisation plan, 2026-11-01), and follow-up questions searched the way Desktop searches a chat turn (the first request of the conversation and the new message, joined by a newline). doc lists the registered document(s) that answer each question; none means outside the organization documents. Used by test/knowledge-paraphrase.test.ts: the score may not drop below its floor, and the floor is raised whenever a retrieval change lifts the score. The 61-question corpus in knowledge-questions.json is separate. reply is what a staff member answers when the app asks back which Skill fits (eval/knowledge-live.ts sends it once); a question with no reply that is asked back is reported as CLARIFY.
